about: Where uaRO differs from its base game data. Item data follows Hercules pre-renewal by default; the lists below override it. Edit this file by hand (see CONTRIBUTING.md). Each entry needs the item's itemId and name exactly as in loot.json.

modifiedSellPrices.about: uaRO lowered these NPC sell prices. The price is the most an NPC pays: Overcharge does NOT raise it.

customSellValues.about: Items uaRO prices differently from both emulators. This is the base price: Overcharge applies on top, like normal items.

items.name: Crystalized Teardrop
items.note: Renewal drop added by uaRO; the emulators list it at 0z.

notSellableToNpc.about: Items NPCs won't buy on purpose (currencies, event coins). The NPC Sell column shows ✕ instead of a price.

renewalContent.about: Renewal areas uaRO added. Drops here may be tweaked by uaRO, so they are NOT added automatically. `npm run sync:prices` only checks the prices of items dropped here against rAthena's renewal data and lists differences for review.
